summary: The implementation covers most requirements related to dynamic product displays, shop details management, and hero section updates. However, it significantly exceeds the scope by introducing extensive shop details fields beyond the requested contact email, and view/sales tracking implementation is incomplete or not clearly evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Product sales count is tracked and persisted when purchases are completed
missing_requirements.reason: The backend main.mo shows viewCount tracking in Product type and incrementProductViewCount method, but there is no evidence of sales tracking being implemented or updated during purchase completion.

hallucinated_features.description: Shop details form includes extensive fields for shop name, full address (street, city, zipcode, country), phone number, opening hours for all weekdays, and company details (VAT ID, Tax ID)
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-47 and REQ-48 explicitly requested only contact email configuration. The implementation added 10+ additional fields including address, phone, opening hours, and company details that were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module created to handle data structure upgrades with viewCount and createdAt fields
hallucinated_features.reason: While adding viewCount and createdAt fields is part of REQ-45, creating a separate migration.mo module with complex migration logic was not requested and represents additional architectural decisions beyond the requirement scope.
